title: Muammo va yechim haqida gapirish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida shahringizdagi muammoni sabab va oqibati bilan tasvirlab, ikki-uch yechim taklif qilasiz, ularni afzallik va kamchiliklari bo‘yicha baholab, sabab bilan bitta tavsiya berasiz.

scenes.title: Muammo va yechim haqida gapirish
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yigirma to‘rtinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda hikoya qilish texnikasini o‘rgandik: tuzilma, zamonlar va intriga. Bugun hayotda va imtihonda juda kerak bo‘ladigan nutq turini o‘rganamiz: muammoni aniq tasvirlash, yechimlar taklif qilish, ularni baholash va oxirida tavsiya berish. Dars oxirida shahringizdagi muammo haqida bir daqiqa tartibli gapira olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we are going to learn how to describe a problem, suggest solutions, judge them, and give a clear recommendation.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun muammoni tasvirlash, yechim taklif qilish, ularni baholash va aniq tavsiya berishni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Nutq tuzilmasi
scenes.say_native: Muammo haqida gapirganda tartib juda muhim. Avval muammoni aytasiz. Keyin sabablari va oqibatlarini. Keyin kamida ikkita yechim taklif qilasiz. So‘ng ularni baholaysiz: qaysi biri arzon, qaysi biri tez, qaysi biri ishlaydi. Oxirida bitta variantni tavsiya qilasiz. Ko‘p o‘quvchi faqat shikoyat qiladi: ‘hammasi yomon’. Bunday nutq ta’sirli emas. Yechim va tavsiya nutqni foydali qiladi.
scenes.say: A good talk about a problem has a clear order: the problem, its causes and effects, some solutions, and finally your recommendation.
scenes.say_uz: Muammo haqidagi yaxshi nutqning tartibi aniq: muammo, sabab va oqibatlar, yechimlar va oxirida tavsiyangiz.

scenes.title: Muammoni nomlash
board: There is a serious problem with ...
... is a big issue / a major concern
We have trouble with ... · ... is getting worse

examples.t: The problem is that there are too many cars.
examples.uz: Muammo shundaki, mashinalar juda ko‘p.

examples.t: There is a serious problem with public transport.
examples.uz: Jamoat transporti bilan jiddiy muammo bor.

scenes.say_native: Muammoni aniq nomlash uchun qoliplar bor. ‘The problem is that...’ — muammo shundaki. ‘There is a problem with...’ — ... bilan muammo bor. ‘... is a big issue’ — katta masala. Yomonlashayotgan holat uchun ‘is getting worse’. Diqqat: ‘The problem is that’ dan keyin to‘liq gap keladi. O‘zbekchada ‘muammo shuki’ deymiz, ingliz tilida ‘that’ ni ba’zan tushirib ham ketish mumkin, lekin yozma nutqda saqlang.
scenes.say: The problem is that there are too many cars. There is a serious problem with public transport. Air pollution is getting worse every year.
scenes.say_uz: Muammo shundaki, mashinalar juda ko‘p. Jamoat transporti bilan jiddiy muammo bor. Havoning ifloslanishi har yili yomonlashib bormoqda.

scenes.title: Sabab va oqibat
board: A causes B · A leads to B · A results in B
As a result, ... · This means that ...

examples.t: Because of the traffic, people arrive late.
examples.uz: Tirbandlik tufayli odamlar kech keladi.

examples.t: Too many cars lead to air pollution.
examples.uz: Mashinalar ko‘pligi havoning ifloslanishiga olib keladi.

scenes.say_native: Muammoning sabab va oqibatini bog‘lang. ‘Because of’ va ‘due to’ dan keyin ot keladi: ‘because of the traffic’. ‘Because’ dan keyin esa to‘liq gap: ‘because there is traffic’. Oqibat uchun ‘cause’, ‘lead to’, ‘result in’ fe’llari, ‘lead to’ dan keyin ot yoki ‘-ing’ shakli keladi. Gap boshida ‘As a result’ — natijada. Bu qoliplar nutqni mantiqiy qiladi, chunki tinglovchi sababni oqibatdan ajratib oladi.
scenes.say: Because of the traffic, people arrive late. Too many cars lead to air pollution. As a result, many children have breathing problems.
scenes.say_uz: Tirbandlik tufayli odamlar kech keladi. Mashinalar ko‘pligi havoning ifloslanishiga olib keladi. Natijada ko‘p bolalarda nafas bilan bog‘liq muammolar bor.

scenes.title: Muammoni tasvirlash
scenes.say_native: Mana muammoni tasvirlashning namunasi. Mavzu: shahar markazidagi tirbandlik. Diqqat qiling: avval muammo nomlanadi, keyin sabab, keyin oqibat. Har gap o‘z vazifasini bajaradi, hech biri takrorlanmaydi. Shu tartibni o‘zingiz ham ishlatasiz.
scenes.say: The main problem in my city is traffic. Because of the number of cars, the roads are full every morning. This leads to long delays and a lot of pollution. As a result, many people feel stressed, and the situation is getting worse every year.
scenes.say_uz: Shahrimdagi asosiy muammo tirbandlik. Mashinalar ko‘pligi tufayli yo‘llar har ertalab to‘la. Bu uzoq kechikishlarga va ko‘p ifloslanishga olib keladi. Natijada ko‘p odam stressni his qiladi va vaziyat har yili yomonlashmoqda.

scenes.title: Muammo tilidagi xatolar
board: ✗ The problem is because there are many cars.
✓ The problem is that there are many cars.
✗ There are a lot of traffics.
✓ There is a lot of traffic.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: ‘The problem is because’. O‘zbekcha ‘muammo shundaki’ ni to‘g‘ri tarjima qiling: ‘The problem is that’. ‘Because’ sabab bildiradi, muammoni emas. Ikkinchisi: ‘traffics’. ‘Traffic’ sanalmaydigan ot, ko‘plik qo‘shimchasi olmaydi. Shuningdek ‘pollution’, ‘noise’, ‘information’ ham sanalmaydi. Biz ‘a lot of traffic’, ‘too much noise’ deymiz. ‘Many noises’ emas.
scenes.say: Say the problem is that, not the problem is because. And traffic has no plural: a lot of traffic, too much noise.
scenes.say_uz: The problem is that deng, the problem is because emas. Traffic ko‘plikda bo‘lmaydi: a lot of traffic, too much noise.

scenes.title: Muammoni ayting
board: 3) rubbish in the streets / dirty city
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har uch holat uchun bitta-ikkita gap tuzing: muammoni ‘the problem is that’ bilan, oqibatini ‘because of’ yoki ‘lead to’ bilan. Birinchi: qurilish shovqini, odamlar yomon uxlaydi. Ikkinchi: avtobuslar yetarli emas, kutish uzoq. Uchinchi: ko‘chalarda axlat, shahar iflos.
scenes.say: Describe each problem. Use the problem is that, and because of or leads to.
scenes.say_uz: Har muammoni tasvirlang. The problem is that va because of yoki leads to dan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) The problem is that there is too much noise. It leads to bad sleep.
2) There are not enough buses. Because of this, people wait for a long time.
3) There is rubbish in the streets, so the city looks dirty.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: ‘The problem is that there is too much noise from the building site. It leads to bad sleep.’ Ikkinchi: ‘The problem is that there are not enough buses. Because of this, people wait for a long time.’ Uchinchi: ‘There is rubbish in the streets, so the city looks dirty.’ Sizning gaplaringiz boshqacha bo‘lsa ham, tuzilma shunday: muammo va oqibat.
scenes.say: The problem is that there is too much noise from the building site. It leads to bad sleep. There are not enough buses, so people wait a long time.
scenes.say_uz: Muammo shundaki, qurilishdan juda ko‘p shovqin bor. Bu yomon uyquga olib keladi. Avtobuslar yetarli emas, shuning uchun odamlar uzoq kutadi.

scenes.title: Muammo bilan kurashish fe’llari
board: solve / tackle / deal with / address a problem
make a difference · find a way to ...

examples.t: The city must tackle the problem of rubbish.
examples.uz: Shahar axlat muammosini hal qilishi kerak.

examples.t: We need to come up with a solution.
examples.uz: Biz yechim topishimiz kerak.

scenes.say_native: Yechimlar haqida gapirishdan oldin foydali fe’llarni bilib oling. ‘Solve a problem’ — muammoni hal qilmoq. ‘Tackle’ va ‘deal with’ — muammoga kirishmoq, u bilan shug‘ullanmoq. ‘Come up with a solution’ — yechim o‘ylab topmoq. ‘Make a difference’ — sezilarli o‘zgarish qilmoq. O‘zbek tilida ‘muammoni hal qilish’ deymiz va hammasiga bitta fe’l ishlatamiz, ingliz tilida esa ‘make a problem’ yoki ‘do a solution’ deb bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say: The city must tackle the problem of rubbish. We need to come up with a solution. Small changes can make a real difference.
scenes.say_uz: Shahar axlat muammosini hal qilishi kerak. Biz yechim topishimiz kerak. Kichik o‘zgarishlar haqiqiy farq yaratishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Yechim taklif qilish: modal fe’llar
board: Why don't we / you ...? · How about + -ing?
We could ... · One option is to ...

examples.t: We should build more cycle lanes.
examples.uz: Biz ko‘proq velosiped yo‘laklari qurishimiz kerak.

examples.t: How about making the bus tickets cheaper?
examples.uz: Avtobus chiptalarini arzonlashtirsak-chi?

scenes.say_native: Endi yechim taklif qilamiz. ‘Should’ — kuchli maslahat: ‘We should build more cycle lanes.’ ‘Could’ — yumshoqroq imkoniyat: ‘We could improve the buses.’ So‘roq ko‘rinishida: ‘Why don’t we...?’ va ‘How about...?’ Diqqat: ‘how about’ dan keyin fe’lning ‘-ing’ shakli keladi. ‘One option is to’ — bir variant shuki. Modal fe’llardan keyin ‘to’ kelmaydi: ‘should build’, ‘to’ siz. Bu o‘zbek o‘quvchilari uchun odatiy xato.
scenes.say: We should build more cycle lanes. We could also make bus tickets cheaper. Why don't we ask people to share cars? How about closing the centre to cars?
scenes.say_uz: Biz ko‘proq velosiped yo‘laklari qurishimiz kerak. Avtobus chiptalarini ham arzonlashtirishimiz mumkin. Nega odamlardan mashinalarni baham ko‘rishni so‘ramaymiz? Markazni mashinalar uchun yopsak-chi?

scenes.title: Suggest, recommend, propose
board: I suggest + -ing / that we + base verb
It would be a good idea to + base verb

examples.t: I suggest introducing a bus lane.
examples.uz: Avtobus yo‘lagini joriy qilishni taklif qilaman.

examples.t: I suggest that we start now.
examples.uz: Hozir boshlashimizni taklif qilaman.

scenes.say_native: ‘Suggest’ fe’lining qoliplari: ‘I suggest’ va ‘-ing’: ‘I suggest introducing a bus lane.’ Yoki ‘I suggest that we’ va asosiy fe’l: ‘I suggest that we start now.’ Britaniya inglizchasida ‘that we should start’ ham uchraydi. Muhim xato: ‘I suggest to introduce’. ‘Suggest’ dan keyin ‘to’ bilan infinitiv kelmaydi. ‘It would be a good idea to’ va ‘I’d recommend’ ham yaxshi muqobillar. Yozma va og‘zaki nutqda xilma-xillik ball beradi.
scenes.say: I suggest introducing a bus lane. I suggest that we start now. It would be a good idea to plant more trees.
scenes.say_uz: Avtobus yo‘lagini joriy qilishni taklif qilaman. Hozir boshlashimizni taklif qilaman. Ko‘proq daraxt ekish yaxshi fikr bo‘lardi.

scenes.title: Taklifdagi xatolar
board: ✗ I suggest to build a park.
✗ We should to ask the mayor.
✗ How about to take the bus?
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. ‘I suggest to build’ noto‘g‘ri, to‘g‘risi ‘I suggest building’. ‘We should to ask’ ham noto‘g‘ri: ‘should’ dan keyin ‘to’ yo‘q. ‘How about to take’ ham xato: ‘how about’ dan keyin ‘-ing’ keladi. Sababi, o‘zbek tilida fe’l shakli ‘-ish’ yoki ‘-moq’ bilan keladi va ko‘pchilik buni ‘to’ bilan tarjima qiladi. Bu uchta qoliplarni yodlab oling.
scenes.say: Say I suggest building, we should ask, how about taking. Never suggest to, should to, or how about to.
scenes.say_uz: I suggest building, we should ask, how about taking deng. Suggest to, should to, how about to demang.

scenes.title: Yechim taklif qiling
board: 3) Problem: little green space → How about ... ?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta muammoga yechim taklif qiling. Birinchi: to‘xtash joyi yo‘q, ‘I suggest’ va ‘-ing’ bilan. Ikkinchi: talabalar charchagan, ‘should’ bilan. Uchinchi: yashil maydon kam, ‘How about’ bilan. Har bir gap qoidaga mos bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Suggest a solution for each problem. Use the structure on the board.
scenes.say_uz: Har muammo uchun yechim taklif qiling. Taxtadagi qolipdan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I suggest building a car park.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar. Birinchi: ‘I suggest building a car park near the station.’ Ikkinchi: ‘Classes should start later in the morning.’ Uchinchi: ‘How about planting more trees along the streets?’ Sizning yechimlaringiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, asosiysi shakl to‘g‘ri bo‘lsin: suggest bilan ‘-ing’, should bilan ‘to’ siz fe’l, how about bilan ‘-ing’.
scenes.say: I suggest building a car park near the station. Classes should start later. How about planting more trees along the streets?
scenes.say_uz: Bekat yonida avtoturargoh qurishni taklif qilaman. Darslar kechroq boshlanishi kerak. Ko‘chalar bo‘ylab ko‘proq daraxt ekamizmi?

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha bilan solishtirish
board: kerak → should / need to / have to
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida ‘kerak’ so‘zi hamma narsani bildiradi: ‘qurish kerak’. Ingliz tilida esa darajalar bor. ‘Should’ — maslahat, ‘need to’ — ehtiyoj, ‘have to’ — majburiyat. Muammo haqida gaplashganda ‘should’ eng mos, chunki u fikrni qat’iy, lekin qo‘pol emas qilib bildiradi. ‘Must’ juda kuchli eshitiladi, shuning uchun taklifda ko‘pincha o‘rinsiz. ‘Mumkin’ so‘zini esa ‘could’ yoki ‘can’ bilan beramiz.
scenes.say: We should build more parks. We need to reduce traffic. People have to pay for parking, so it is not free.
scenes.say_uz: Biz ko‘proq bog‘lar qurishimiz kerak. Tirbandlikni kamaytirishimiz kerak. Odamlar to‘xtash uchun pul to‘lashi shart, shuning uchun bepul emas.

scenes.title: Variantlarni baholash
board: The advantage / benefit is ... · The drawback is ...
It would be effective / affordable / realistic
On the plus side, ... · On the downside, ...

examples.t: The advantage is that it is cheap.
examples.uz: Afzalligi shundaki, u arzon.

examples.t: On the downside, it takes a long time.
examples.uz: Salbiy tomoni shuki, u uzoq vaqt oladi.

scenes.say_native: Yechimlarni baholash — nutqning eng muhim qismi. Afzallik uchun ‘the advantage is that’ yoki ‘on the plus side’. Kamchilik uchun ‘the drawback is that’ yoki ‘on the downside’. Baholovchi sifatlar: ‘effective’ — samarali, ‘affordable’ — hamyonbop, ‘realistic’ — amalga oshirish mumkin. ‘Advantage’ va ‘disadvantage’ qarama-qarshi so‘zlar. Ikkala tomonni aytish nutqingizni xolis va ishonarli qiladi.
scenes.say: Cycle lanes are affordable, and the advantage is that they are good for health. On the downside, they take space from cars. Bus lanes would be effective, but expensive.
scenes.say_uz: Velosiped yo‘laklari hamyonbop, afzalligi shundaki, ular salomatlik uchun yaxshi. Salbiy tomoni, ular mashinalar joyini oladi. Avtobus yo‘laklari samarali bo‘lardi, lekin qimmat.

scenes.title: Oqibatni bashorat qilish: if
board: If we build bike lanes, more people will cycle. (real)
If the city built more lanes, fewer people would drive. (imaginary)

examples.t: If we raise the price of parking, fewer people will drive.
examples.uz: Agar to‘xtash narxini oshirsak, kamroq odam mashina haydaydi.

examples.t: If the buses were cheaper, more people would use them.
examples.uz: Agar avtobuslar arzonroq bo‘lsa, ko‘proq odam ulardan foydalanardi.

scenes.say_native: Yechim ishlashini ko‘rsatish uchun ‘if’ ishlatamiz. Real imkoniyat uchun: ‘If we raise the price of parking, fewer people will drive.’ ‘If’ dan keyin hozirgi zamon, asosiy qismda ‘will’. Ehtimoliy, nazariy holat uchun: ‘If the buses were cheaper, more people would use them.’ Bunda ‘if’ dan keyin past, asosiy qismda ‘would’. Ishonchsiz bo‘lsangiz, ‘might’ qo‘shing. Muhim: ‘if’ dan keyin ‘will’ ishlatilmaydi.
scenes.say: If we build bike lanes, more people will cycle. If the buses were cheaper, more people would use them. It might not solve everything.
scenes.say_uz: Agar velosiped yo‘laklari qursak, ko‘proq odam velosipedda yuradi. Agar avtobuslar arzonroq bo‘lsa, ko‘proq odam ulardan foydalanardi. Bu hammasini hal qilmasligi mumkin.

scenes.title: Baholashdagi xatolar
board: ✗ If we will build lanes, people will cycle.
✓ If we build lanes, people will cycle.
✓ The advantage is that it is cheap.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: ‘if’ dan keyin ‘will’. To‘g‘risi ‘if we build’. Ikkinchisi: ‘The advantage is cheap’, bu yerda ‘that it is’ yoki ‘it is’ kerak, chunki ‘advantage’ ot, sifat emas. Uchinchisi: taqqoslashda ‘that’ o‘rniga ‘than’. Bu oxirgisini o‘tgan darsda ham ko‘rgan edik. Kamchiliklarni ham xuddi shunday: ‘the drawback is that it is slow’. ‘That’ dan keyin to‘liq gap keladi.
scenes.say: After if, use the present: if we build. After advantage, say that it is, not just cheap. And use than for comparing.
scenes.say_uz: If dan keyin hozirgi zamon: if we build. Advantage dan keyin that it is deng. Taqqoslashda than ishlating.

scenes.title: Variantlarni solishtirish
scenes.say_native: Endi baholashning to‘liq namunasini eshiting. Mavzu: yangi metro yoki ko‘proq avtobus. Ikkala variant uchun afzallik va kamchilik aytiladi, ‘if’ bilan oqibat bashorat qilinadi va taqqoslash ham bor. Yaxshi nutq xolis: u har ikki tomonni ko‘rsatadi, keyin tanlaydi.
scenes.say: There are two options. A new metro line would be very effective, because it is fast. On the downside, it is extremely expensive and takes years. More buses would be cheaper than a metro, and they could start next year. If the city bought fifty buses, waiting times would fall quickly.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki variant bor. Yangi metro liniyasi juda samarali bo‘lardi, chunki tez. Salbiy tomoni, u o‘ta qimmat va yillar oladi. Ko‘proq avtobuslar metrodan arzonroq bo‘lardi va kelgusi yili ishga tushishi mumkin. Agar shahar ellikta avtobus sotib olsa, kutish vaqti tez kamayardi.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: nega metro samarali? Ikkinchi: uning salbiy tomoni nima? Uchinchi: kelgusi yili nima ishga tushishi mumkin va u metrodan nimasi bilan farq qiladi? To‘liq gap bilan javob bering.
scenes.say: Why is the metro effective? What is its downside? What could start next year?
scenes.say_uz: Nega metro samarali? Uning salbiy tomoni nima? Kelgusi yili nima ishga tushishi mumkin?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) More buses: cheaper than a metro
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: metro tez, shuning uchun samarali. Ikkinchi: u o‘ta qimmat va qurilishi yillar oladi. Uchinchi: ko‘proq avtobuslar kelgusi yili ishga tushishi mumkin va ular metrodan arzonroq. Matnda ‘on the downside’, ‘cheaper than’ va ‘if the city bought’ iboralari ishlatildi: bugungi baholash qoliplari.
scenes.say: The metro is fast. It is extremely expensive and takes years. More buses could start next year, and they are cheaper than a metro.
scenes.say_uz: Metro tez. U o‘ta qimmat va yillar oladi. Ko‘proq avtobuslar kelgusi yili ishga tushishi mumkin va ular metrodan arzonroq.

scenes.title: Tavsiya berish
board: The best option is to ... · In my opinion, ... would be the most effective

examples.t: I would recommend starting with more buses.
examples.uz: Ko‘proq avtobuslardan boshlashni tavsiya qilaman.

examples.t: In my opinion, this would be the most effective solution.
examples.uz: Mening fikrimcha, bu eng samarali yechim bo‘lardi.

scenes.say_native: Tavsiya nutqning yakuni. Qoliplar: ‘I would recommend’ va ‘-ing’, ‘The best option is to’ va fe’l, ‘In my opinion, ... would be the most effective’. Tavsiya sababsiz bo‘lmaydi, shuning uchun ‘because’ qo‘shing. Eng yaxshi shakl: tanlov, sabab, kutilgan natija. Masalan: ‘I would recommend more buses, because they are cheap and quick, so people will use them soon.’ ‘Recommend to’ deb aytmaymiz, bu ham ‘suggest’ kabi ‘-ing’ talab qiladi.
scenes.say: I would recommend starting with more buses, because they are cheap and quick. In my opinion, this would be the most effective solution for now.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘proq avtobuslardan boshlashni tavsiya qilaman, chunki ular arzon va tez. Mening fikrimcha, hozircha bu eng samarali yechim bo‘lardi.

scenes.title: Tavsiyadagi xatolar
board: ✗ I recommend to start with buses.
✗ I recommend you to take the bus.
✓ I recommend that you take the bus.
✗ The most effective solution, I think. (sababsiz)
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: ‘recommend to start’. To‘g‘risi ‘recommend starting’. Ikkinchisi: ‘recommend you to take’. Bu noto‘g‘ri, kerakli shakl: ‘I recommend that you take’ yoki ‘I recommend taking’. Uchinchisi: tavsiyani sababsiz qoldirish. Tinglovchi nega shu variantni tanlaganingizni bilishi kerak. Eslang: ‘suggest’ va ‘recommend’ bir xil qoliplarni talab qiladi.
scenes.say: I recommend starting with buses. I recommend that you take the bus. Always give a reason: because they are cheaper.
scenes.say_uz: Avtobuslardan boshlashni tavsiya qilaman. Avtobusda yurishingizni tavsiya qilaman. Doim sabab keltiring: chunki ular arzonroq.

scenes.title: Tavsiya bering
board: Problem: students cannot find quiet places to study
Options: new library · longer opening hours
Recommend one and give a reason.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Muammo: talabalar tinch o‘qish joyini topa olmaydi. Ikki variant: yangi kutubxona yoki mavjud kutubxonaning ish vaqtini uzaytirish. Bittasini ‘I would recommend’ bilan tavsiya qiling, sabab ‘because’ bilan va kutilgan natijani ayting. Baland ovozda gapiring.
scenes.say: Students cannot find quiet places to study. Recommend one option and give a reason.
scenes.say_uz: Talabalar tinch o‘qish joyini topa olmaydi. Bitta variantni tavsiya qiling va sabab keltiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: I would recommend longer opening hours, because it is cheaper and faster.
Result: students could study in the evenings.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob. ‘I would recommend longer opening hours, because it is cheaper and faster than building a new library. If the library stayed open until ten, students could study in the evenings.’ Sizning tanlovingiz boshqa bo‘lishi mumkin, masalan yangi kutubxona. Muhimi — sabab va natijani qo‘shganingiz.
scenes.say: I would recommend longer opening hours, because it is cheaper and faster than building a new library. If it stayed open until ten, students could study in the evenings.
scenes.say_uz: Ish vaqtini uzaytirishni tavsiya qilaman, chunki bu yangi kutubxona qurishdan arzonroq va tezroq. Agar u o‘nigacha ochiq tursa, talabalar kechqurun o‘qishlari mumkin.

scenes.title: Muloyim va ehtiyotkor til
board: I'm afraid that ... · Perhaps / Maybe we could ...
It might not be ... · It seems that ...

examples.t: I see your point, but it might be too expensive.
examples.uz: Fikringizni tushunaman, lekin bu juda qimmat bo‘lishi mumkin.

examples.t: Perhaps we could try a smaller solution first.
examples.uz: Balki avval kichikroq yechimni sinab ko‘rarmiz.

scenes.say_native: Taklif va tanqid qilganda ohangni yumshating. ‘Perhaps we could’ — balki qilsak bo‘ladi. ‘It might not be’ — bo‘lmasligi mumkin. ‘I see your point, but’ — fikringizni tushunaman, lekin. Bu iboralar ayniqsa muhokamada kerak, chunki o‘zbek tilidagi ‘yo‘q, bu noto‘g‘ri’ ning to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri tarjimasi, ya’ni ‘No, it is wrong’, inglizcha qo‘pol eshitiladi.
scenes.say: I see your point, but it might be too expensive. Perhaps we could try a smaller solution first. I'm afraid it will not solve everything.
scenes.say_uz: Fikringizni tushunaman, lekin bu juda qimmat bo‘lishi mumkin. Balki avval kichikroq yechimni sinab ko‘rarmiz. Afsuski, bu hammasini hal qilmaydi.

scenes.title: Tinglang: uy yig‘ilishi
board: What is the problem in the building?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialog. Bir uyning uch qo‘shnisi, Karim, Emma va Sam, yig‘ilishda yangi muammoni muhokama qilmoqda. Tinglang va quyidagilarni aniqlang: uyda qanday muammo bor, qaysi yechimlar aytiladi va ular nimaga qaror qilishadi. Taklif va baholash iboralariga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: The problem is that the stairs are very noisy at night. How about putting carpet on them? That would be effective, but it is expensive. I suggest asking everyone to wear soft shoes. I'm afraid people will forget. Then I would recommend the carpet, because it solves the problem for good. Fine. If we all pay a little, it will be affordable.
scenes.say_uz: Muammo shundaki, zinapoyalar kechqurun juda shovqinli. Ularga gilam to‘shasak-chi? Bu samarali bo‘lardi, lekin qimmat. Hammadan yumshoq poyabzal kiyishni so‘rashni taklif qilaman. Afsuski, odamlar unutadi. Unda men gilamni tavsiya qilaman, chunki u muammoni butunlay hal qiladi. Yaxshi. Agar hammamiz ozgina to‘lasak, bu hamyonbop bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 3) What do they choose and why?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: uyda qanday muammo bor? Ikkinchi: nega yumshoq poyabzal kiyish taklifi yaxshi emas deyiladi? Uchinchi: ular qaysi yechimni tanlaydi va nega? Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say: What is the problem? Why not soft shoes? What do they choose, and why?
scenes.say_uz: Muammo nima? Nega yumshoq poyabzal emas? Ular nimani tanlaydi va nega?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) The stairs are noisy at night.
3) The carpet, because it solves the problem for good.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: zinapoyalar tunda shovqinli. Ikkinchi: odamlar yumshoq poyabzalni unutadi. Uchinchi: ular gilamni tanlaydi, chunki bu muammoni butunlay hal qiladi, hamma ozgina to‘lasa, narxi ham muammo bo‘lmaydi. Dialogda ‘how about’ va ‘-ing’, ‘I suggest’, ‘I’d recommend’ va ‘if we all pay’ iboralari ishlatildi.
scenes.say: The stairs are noisy at night. People would forget soft shoes. They choose the carpet, because it solves the problem for good.
scenes.say_uz: Zinapoyalar tunda shovqinli. Odamlar yumshoq poyabzalni unutardi. Ular gilamni tanlaydi, chunki u muammoni butunlay hal qiladi.

scenes.title: Tinglang: ish joyidagi muammo
board: What is the problem at the office?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Ish joyida ikki hamkasb, Nina va Omar, ko‘p uchrashuvlar muammosini muhokama qilmoqda. Tinglang: muammo nima, Nina nimani taklif qiladi va uning kamchiligi nima. Omar nimani tavsiya qilishini ham eshiting.
scenes.say: We have too many meetings, and I never finish my own work. Because of this, I stay late almost every day. Why don't we have shorter meetings? On the plus side, they would save time. On the downside, people might not have enough time to talk. Then I'd recommend one meeting-free afternoon every week. If we try it for a month, we will see the results.
scenes.say_uz: Bizda yig‘ilishlar juda ko‘p va men o‘z ishimni hech tugatolmayman. Shu sababli deyarli har kuni kech qolaman. Nega yig‘ilishlarni qisqartirmaymiz? Ijobiy tomoni, ular vaqtni tejaydi. Salbiy tomoni, odamlarning gaplashishga vaqti yetmasligi mumkin. Unda men har hafta bir kunni yig‘ilishsiz o‘tkazishni tavsiya qilaman. Agar bir oy sinab ko‘rsak, natijani ko‘ramiz.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) Why does the speaker stay late?
2) What is the plus and the downside of shorter meetings?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: nega gapiruvchi kech qoladi? Ikkinchi: qisqa yig‘ilishlarning ijobiy va salbiy tomoni nima? Uchinchi: yakuniy tavsiya nima va u qancha vaqt sinab ko‘riladi? Javob bering.
scenes.say: Why does the speaker stay late? What are the plus and the downside? What is the final recommendation?
scenes.say_uz: Gapiruvchi nega kech qoladi? Ijobiy va salbiy tomon nima? Yakuniy tavsiya nima?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Too many meetings; work is unfinished
2) Plus: saves time. Downside: less time to talk
3) One meeting-free afternoon a week, for one month
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: yig‘ilishlar ko‘p, shuning uchun o‘z ishi tugamaydi. Ikkinchi: ijobiy tomoni — vaqtni tejaydi, salbiy tomoni — gaplashishga vaqt kam bo‘lishi mumkin. Uchinchi: har hafta bir yig‘ilishsiz tushdan keyin, buni bir oy sinab ko‘rishadi. E’tibor bering: ‘on the plus side’ va ‘on the downside’ juft bo‘lib keladi.
scenes.say: Too many meetings. Shorter meetings save time but leave less time to talk. They recommend one meeting-free afternoon a week for a month.
scenes.say_uz: Yig‘ilishlar juda ko‘p. Qisqa yig‘ilishlar vaqtni tejaydi, lekin gaplashishga vaqt kamroq qoladi. Ular oyiga bir yig‘ilishsiz tushdan keyinni tavsiya qilishadi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: urg‘u va ro‘yxat ohangi
scenes.say_native: Talaffuzda uchta narsa. Birinchi, urg‘u: ‘problem’ da urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda, ‘solution’ da ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: ‘so-LU-tion’. ‘Suggest’ da ham ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: ‘sug-GEST’. Ikkinchi, kuchsiz shakllar: ‘could’ va ‘should’ gapda ‘kəd’, ‘shəd’ kabi qisqa aytiladi. Uchinchi, ro‘yxat ohangi: ro‘yxatda har elementda ovoz biroz ko‘tariladi, oxirgisida esa pasayadi. Bu tinglovchiga ro‘yxat tugaganini bildiradi.
scenes.say: We could build parks, plant trees, and close some roads. I suggest a solution. The problem is serious.
scenes.say_uz: Biz bog‘lar qurishimiz, daraxt ekishimiz va ba’zi yo‘llarni yopishimiz mumkin. Men yechim taklif qilaman. Muammo jiddiy.

scenes.title: Ohang bilan takrorlang
board: We could build parks ↗, plant trees ↗, and close roads ↘.
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Birinchi gapda ro‘yxat ohangiga e’tibor bering: ikki marta ko‘tariladi, oxirida pasayadi. Ikkinchi gapda ‘suggest’ va ‘solution’ ning urg‘usini to‘g‘ri qo‘ying. ‘Could’ ni qisqa va yengil ayting. Bir necha marta takrorlang.
scenes.say: We could build parks, plant trees, and close roads. I suggest a solution. The problem is serious.
scenes.say_uz: Biz bog‘lar qursak, daraxt ekib, yo‘llarni yopsak bo‘ladi. Men yechim taklif qilaman. Muammo jiddiy.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Natija. Agar ro‘yxatda ovozingiz ko‘tarilib, oxirida tushgan bo‘lsa, to‘g‘ri aytdingiz. Urg‘uni eslang: ‘PROB-lem’, ‘sug-GEST’, ‘so-LU-tion’. Kuchsiz ‘could’ nutqingizni tabiiy qiladi, to‘liq ‘kud’ deyish sun’iy eshitiladi. Bu odat tez ravon gapirishga yordam beradi.
scenes.say: Parks, trees, and fewer roads. Problem, suggest, solution. The stress is different in each word.
scenes.say_uz: Bog‘lar, daraxtlar va kamroq yo‘llar. Muammo, taklif, yechim. Har so‘zda urg‘u boshqacha.

scenes.title: Shahar muammolari leksikasi

examples.t: There is a shortage of affordable housing.
examples.uz: Hamyonbop uy-joy yetishmaydi.

examples.t: Rising prices are a problem for young people.
examples.uz: Narxlarning oshishi yoshlar uchun muammo.

scenes.say_native: Muammo haqida gapirish uchun aniq so‘z kerak. ‘A shortage of’ — yetishmovchilik: ‘a shortage of housing’. ‘Overcrowding’ — gavjumlik. ‘Litter’ — ko‘chadagi axlat, ‘pollution’ — ifloslanish. ‘Unemployment’ — ishsizlik, ‘rising prices’ — narxlarning oshishi. Muhim: ‘a lack of’ va ‘a shortage of’ dan keyin ot keladi. ‘Lack’ ko‘pincha sanalmaydigan otlar bilan: ‘a lack of time’. Shu so‘zlar nutqingizni aniq va professional qiladi.
scenes.say: There is a shortage of affordable housing. Overcrowding and rising prices are also serious problems for young people.
scenes.say_uz: Hamyonbop uy-joy yetishmaydi. Gavjumlik va narxlarning oshishi ham yoshlar uchun jiddiy muammolar.

scenes.title: Mos so‘zni toping
board: 1) There is a ___ of doctors in the village. (shortage / lack)
2) ___ is rubbish on the street. (litter / noise)
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Bo‘sh joylarga mos so‘zni tanlang. Birinchi: qishloqda shifokorlar yetishmaydi. Ikkinchi: ko‘chadagi axlat uchun qaysi so‘z mos? Uchinchi: narxlar o‘sishi haqida to‘g‘ri shaklni toping. ‘Rising’ yoki ‘raising’? Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Choose the best word for each gap. Think about the meaning.
scenes.say_uz: Har bo‘sh joy uchun eng mos so‘zni tanlang. Ma’noga e’tibor bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: ‘a shortage of doctors’, ‘a lack of doctors’ ham to‘g‘ri. Ikkinchi: ‘Litter’, ya’ni ko‘chadagi axlat. Uchinchi: ‘Rising prices’. ‘Rise’ o‘timsiz fe’l, o‘zi ko‘tariladi, ‘raise’ esa nimanidir ko‘taradi: ‘They raised prices’. ‘Raising prices’ ham mumkin, lekin uni kim qilayotgani aytiladi.
scenes.say: A shortage of doctors. Litter on the street. Rising prices make life hard.
scenes.say_uz: Shifokorlar yetishmaydi. Ko‘chada axlat. Narxlarning oshishi hayotni qiyinlashtiradi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy nutq rejasi
board: Problem: The main problem in my city is ...
Cause/effect: Because of ... this leads to ...
Evaluation + recommendation: The advantage ... I would recommend ...
scenes.say_native: Endi yakuniy topshiriqqa tayyorlanamiz. Reja to‘rt qadamdan iborat. Muammoni nomlang. Sabab va oqibatini ayting. Ikki-uch yechim taklif qiling. Har birini baholab, bittasini tavsiya qiling. Bu reja yarim daqiqada tayyor bo‘ladi. Hamma gaplarni yozmang, faqat kalit so‘zlarni yozing va ularga tayanib gapiring.
scenes.say: Plan your talk in four steps: the problem, its causes and effects, two or three solutions, and your recommendation.
scenes.say_uz: Nutqingizni to‘rt qadamda rejalang: muammo, sabab va oqibat, ikki-uch yechim va tavsiya.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: shahar muammosi
board: Topic: a problem in a city (noise, traffic, rubbish, housing)
Recommend one: I would recommend ... because ...
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Shahar yoki mahallangizdagi bitta muammoni tanlang. Uni tasvirlang, ikkita yechim taklif qiling, har birining afzalligi va kamchiligini ayting va bittasini sabab bilan tavsiya qiling. Taxminan bir daqiqa gapiring. Video to‘xtaganda boshlang.
scenes.say: Choose a problem in your city. Describe it, suggest two solutions, judge them, and recommend one. Start now.
scenes.say_uz: Shahringizdagi bir muammoni tanlang. Uni tasvirlang, ikki yechim taklif qiling, baholang va bittasini tavsiya qiling. Boshlang.

scenes.title: Namunaviy nutq
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. ‘The problem in my area is rubbish in the streets. Because there are too few bins, people throw it on the ground, which makes the area look dirty. We could put in more bins, or we could organise clean-up days. More bins would be effective, but they cost money. Clean-up days are cheap, but they only help for a short time. I would recommend more bins, because the effect lasts longer.’ Sizda shunday tuzilma bormi?
scenes.say: The problem in my area is rubbish in the streets. Because there are too few bins, people throw it on the ground. We could put in more bins, or organise clean-up days. I would recommend more bins, because the effect lasts longer.
scenes.say_uz: Mening mahallamdagi muammo ko‘chalardagi axlat. Axlat qutilari kam bo‘lgani uchun odamlar uni yerga tashlaydi. Ko‘proq quti qo‘yishimiz yoki tozalash kunlarini o‘tkazishimiz mumkin. Ko‘proq qutini tavsiya qilaman, chunki natijasi uzoqroq saqlanadi.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: The problem is that ... · because of · leads to
I suggest -ing · We should / could · How about -ing?
The advantage is ... · If we ..., ... will ...
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Muammoni ‘the problem is that’ bilan nomladik, sabab va oqibatni ‘because of’ va ‘lead to’ bilan bog‘ladik. Yechimlarni ‘should’, ‘could’, ‘suggest’ va ‘how about’ bilan taklif qildik. Ularni afzallik, kamchilik va ‘if’ bilan baholadik. Oxirida ‘I would recommend’ bilan sabablarni keltirib tavsiya berdik. Va xatolar: ‘suggest to’, ‘should to’, ‘if will’.
scenes.say: Well done. Now you can describe a problem, suggest and evaluate solutions, and recommend the best one clearly.
scenes.say_uz: Barakalla. Endi muammoni tasvirlab, yechimlarni taklif qilib, baholab va eng yaxshisini aniq tavsiya qila olasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Describe a problem in your city and 3 solutions
Include: cause/effect, 3 suggestions, pros and cons, recommendation
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Shahringizdagi bir muammoni tasvirlang va uchta yechim taklif qiling, ovozingizni yozib oling. Mezon: muammo, sabab va oqibat, uchta xilma-xil taklif qolipi, har bir yechimning afzalligi va kamchiligi va sabab bilan bitta tavsiya bo‘lsin. Yozuvni tinglab, ‘suggest to’ va ‘if will’ xatolari yo‘qligini tekshiring. Keyingi darsda B1 darajasining yakuniy imtihoniga tayyorlanamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to describe a problem in your city and three solutions. Record it. See you in the next lesson.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz shahringizdagi muammo va uchta yechimni tasvirlash. Uni yozib oling. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz.

homework_uz: Shahringizdagi bir muammoni tasvirlang va uchta yechim taklif qiling, 1–2 daqiqalik ovoz yozing. Mezon: muammo va uning sababi hamda oqibati; uchta turli taklif qolipi (I suggest -ing, We could, How about -ing); har bir yechimning afzalligi va kamchiligi; “I would recommend … because …” bilan bitta tavsiya. Yozuvni tinglab, suggest to va if will xatolari yo‘qligini tekshiring.

quiz.q: The problem ___ there are too many cars.
quiz.why_uz: Muammoni nomlash: The problem is that + to‘liq gap.

options: There are a lot of traffics.
There is a lot of traffic.
quiz.why_uz: Traffic sanalmaydigan ot: a lot of traffic.
Because of + ot: because of the noise.

options: I suggest to build a park.
I suggest for building a park.
quiz.why_uz: Suggest dan keyin -ing yoki that we + fe’l keladi.
Should dan keyin to‘siz asosiy shakl.

quiz.q: If the city ___ more buses, people will use them.
quiz.why_uz: Real shartda if dan keyin hozirgi zamon: if the city buys.
The drawback is that — kamchilikni bildiradi.

options: I recommend you to start now.
quiz.why_uz: Recommend dan keyin -ing yoki that you + fe’l.

quiz.q: Which is the best final sentence of the talk?
options: I would recommend more buses, because they are cheap and fast.
quiz.why_uz: Tavsiya tanlov va sababdan iborat bo‘lishi kerak.
